actions.script: const result=ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.report.ReportServices.push#DefinitionGitSync').parameters({syncId}).call() if (result && !ec.message.hasError()) ec.message.addMessage('Wrote '+(result.written || 0)+' files; '+(result.unchanged || 0)+' already the same')

label.text: Git sync needs the REPORT_GIT_SYNC_ADMIN grant.

Each definition of a folder is a JSON file in the repository directory. Saving a definition writes its file; a push or fetch to the repository saves the files that changed. Both run as the sync's user.
